title: spec(types)!: remove BaseSchema's index signature from the authoring face, declare the riders, pin the compile-fail — executes the #7927 removal ruling (governed: AGENTS.md #0.1)
body:
Priced by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat on **#7935**. ⛔ Filed unassigned, not claiming.

`Blocked-by: #8345` · `Blocked-by: #8648` · `Blocked-by: #8649` · `Blocked-by: #8650` · `Blocked-by: #8651` · `Blocked-by: #8652` · `Blocked-by: #8653` · `Blocked-by: #8654` · `Blocked-by: #8655`

> ## ⭐ RE-SCOPED 2026-09-09T00:1xZ by the `domain:spec@objectui` seat — the previous body's blast radius was 2.8× understated
>
> Ruled at **#8327 `5587717012`, option A** («re-scope now, do not let #8347 discover it mid-flight»), on the measurement at **#8327 `5587605667`**. What changed is below under **The blast radius, corrected**; ⛔ nothing about the ruling, the direction, or the governed status changed. Card moved `pm:queue` → **`pm:blocked`**, which is the state its `Blocked-by:` lines already implied.

This is the TypeScript half of the #5250 ruling — *"the TypeScript side gets the matching authoring types without the `[key: string]: any` index signature ... so an invented or misspelled key is distinguishable from a declared one at the authoring site"* — and it is the execution of **#7927**, ruled 2026-09-07 (director seat, decision batch #68): the direction is **removal**, and the TypeScript face becomes an executable contract.

⚠️ **The AGENTS.md §5 #0.1 amendment rides here, and it makes this PR governed** (draft PR + human merge). It belongs with this card, not earlier, because the amendment should describe what shipped rather than what was intended.

## What is being removed, and what inherits it

Measured at `origin/main` **`fa7d66c45`** by #7581's TypeScript-face census, re-confirmed present at `5505aec`:

- `[key: string]: any` is declared at **12 sites** in `packages/types/src`.
- **120 interfaces `extends BaseSchema` directly** and inherit it.
- The two the ruling cites as `base.ts` lines 409 / 441 are, located by content, **467** (`BaseSchema`) and **499** (`ComponentRendererProps`). ⚠️ **The second is the renderer props type, not an authoring type** — out of scope for a card about the authoring face, and conflating them is the first way this card goes wrong.

## ⭐ The blast radius, corrected — **112 reads / 88 keys / 23 files**, ⛔ not 58 / 21

This card previously carried *"58 real code reads across 21 files"* from #8327. **That figure does not reproduce**, and #8327 falsified it against its own instrument, its own population and its own ref (`5587605667`):

| row | at `c842594` (the figure's own ref) | this card used to say | at `154fe2a` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| production files in the population | 1596 | 1596 | 1598 |
| raw text (comments + string literals in) | 92 keys / 27 files | 92 keys / 27 files | 92 keys / 27 files |
| **stripped** | **89 keys / 24 files / 113 reads** | **58 keys / 21 files** | **88 keys / 23 files / 112 reads** |

The **raw** row reproduces exactly, which localises the defect: `58/21` describes #8327's own per-file table, and that table is a **strict subset** of the read set — `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` alone carries **31** cast reads and was absent from it (58 + 31 = 89). ⛔ Every one of the 58 keys is real; the population was understated, never overstated.

### The three-way split, which is what actually re-scopes this card

| class | reads | what it is | what it owes |
| --- | --: | --- | --- |
| **(a)** | **29** | genuinely undeclared on the type the renderer is handed, and read | ⛔ **a ruling each**, ⛔ not a declaration |
| **(b)/(a)** | **8** | union `schema`; the key is declared on exactly ONE arm | a per-arm decision |
| **(b)** | **38** | declared — the cast is stale, or forced by an untyped local | ordinary cleanup, ⛔ not this card |
| **(c)** | **31** | ⭐ **ALREADY RULED non-author surface**, with in-repo pins | ⛔ **NEVER declare** |
| **(c?)** | **1** | the same producer-derived key as a (c) ruling, unpinned at its site | a pin, or a ruling |
| **(d)** | **5** | ⛔ **NOT ANSWERABLE** — the renderer is handed `any` | a typing fix first |

⭐ **31 of the 112 must NEVER be declared** — the #5091 grid ruling (pinned by `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridNonAuthorKeys.test.tsx`) and the #5097 host-composition ruling of 2026-08-18 (27 keys, pinned by `plugin-view/src/__tests__/objectViewHostSurface.test.tsx`). Both docblocks say the cast is **deliberate**. A sweep that read "cast and undeclared" as "needs a declaration" would have walked into two standing rulings and, per the #5097 docblock, silently blanked a stored app-shell document on the way.

⚠️ **And class (a) is a routing bucket, not a verdict.** Four of the 29 — `ChartRenderer.tsx`'s `categories`, `category`, `index`, `value` — sit under *"Adapt the Tremor/simple format"*: an explicit foreign dialect whose remedy is enforce-or-remove **at the producer**. Declaring them would fossilize a second authoring vocabulary, which AGENTS.md #0.1 forbids.

## ⛔ The hard split condition is ALREADY MET — this card SPLITS, it does not grow

The previous body set it as: *"the 58 reads turn out to need more than the declarations already catalogued (i.e. any read that needs a **contract decision**, not just a declaration)."*

That is satisfied **before anyone starts**, by measurement rather than by discovery: **31** ruled never-declare · **4** foreign-dialect (producer-side) · **5** unanswerable · **8** needing a per-arm decision. Those are contract decisions, ⛔ not declarations.

⇒ Per this card's own rule, the remainder becomes other cards. **It has**: the class-(a) adjudication was ruled (#8327 `5587717012`, Q2 option A) to be **one card per reader package**, and those are filed — **#8648 · #8649 · #8650 · #8651 · #8652 · #8653 · #8654 · #8655** (eight; the eighth was declared as a deviation, for the class-(d) half the ruled unit of seven left uncarried). **They are this card's inputs**, hence the `Blocked-by:` lines above.

## ⚠️ A named, falsifiable premise this card now carries — and the fork if it fails

The previous body called #8327's census *"real code reads that would stop compiling"* and *"the load-bearing number for the removal's blast radius."*

⛔ **The census does not establish that property.** Every one of the 112 is a `(schema as any).KEY` read; `as any` erases the type, so property access compiles **whatever** `BaseSchema` declares. Removing the index signature cannot break a cast read by construction. What the census establishes is the **size and shape of the undeclared surface** — which is what makes it valuable — ⛔ not a compile blast radius.

⇒ **The compile blast radius of the removal is UNMEASURED.** It is carried as a premise, ⛔ not as a fact:

> **Premise P1.** Removing `[key: string]: any` from `BaseSchema` breaks only *un-cast* reads and *object-literal authoring* with extra keys, and the count of those is small enough for this card's appetite.
> **Re-check command (the implementer's first act, before any other work):** in a dedicated worktree, delete the index signature from `BaseSchema` alone and run `pnpm -r type-check`, capturing the exit code before any pipe and enumerating every error by file and key.
> ⛔ **If P1 fails** — if that run produces a population this card's appetite cannot carry — **report the fork and stop.** ⛔ Do not grow the card to fit the number; that is the same failure this card was just re-scoped to undo.

⭐ The PM seat ⛔ never writes code, so it cannot run that experiment; it is the implementer's, and it is named here so it cannot be skipped or answered from prose.

## The pin

Per #7927: **a fixture with a misspelled key must stop type-checking.** ⛔ Not a runtime assertion — a compile-fail pin, in **both** directions (the correct spelling must still compile). #7927's own probe set is the model: P5 (rename a key, predicted GREEN, came back GREEN) is the exact case that must flip to RED.

## Appetite — the removal and its pin, and nothing that owes a ruling

**The appetite is: the removal on `BaseSchema`, the compile-fail pin, the AGENTS.md #0.1 amendment, and the declarations that the per-package rulings have ALREADY adjudicated by the time this is dispatched.** ⛔ Not the 29. ⛔ Not #7804's 39 handler keys, which drain through their own `KNOWN_UNDECLARED_READS` ledger.

⛔ **Hard split conditions — hit any one and the remainder is a new card:**

- **P1 fails** (above).
- Any read needs a **contract decision** that its per-package card has not yet answered ⇒ it stays with that card.
- Any rider needs a public-surface widening that is not already ruled.
- `ComponentRendererProps` (`base.ts:499`) turns out to need the signature kept — it is renderer props, and this card ⛔ must not remove it by momentum.

**⛔ Out of scope:** the zod face (#8345 owns it); the other 10 index-signature sites in `packages/types/src` that are not the authoring face (`QueryParams`, `AggregateResult`, `ActionContext`, `FormField`, …) — each its own liveness question, with #7497 as the precedent for one at a time.

## The other two rider instruments — unchanged, and neither is load-bearing

**① Cards that name the mechanism.** 49 open cards match `passthrough` / `[key: string]: any` / `index signature` / `BaseSchemaCore` over the complete 2026-09-07 enumeration (445 issues + 8 PRs = 453, cross-checked against `open_issues_count` 453). Controls: a fabricated token returns 0, `objectui` returns 317. ⚠️ Naming the mechanism is not riding it — a population to triage, ⛔ not 49 riders.

**③ Reads a renderer performs that no arm declares.** **#7804**: 39 handler keys, already draining through `KNOWN_UNDECLARED_READS`. Population derived on both halves — 106 arms, 216 registrations, 62 reachable reads.

Named riders, each with its own card and disposition: **#7780** (`ObjectKanban` inline `data`) · **#7925** (six doc-authored `object-calendar` keys) · **#7924** / **#7928** (`NamedListView`, and the undecided value type) · **#8174** (`filter` / `sort` — its own body says it *"should decide whether that is worth the edit, or whether it should wait behind #7927"* ⇒ **it waits**) · **#6152** (121 declared-but-unmirrored keys) · **#5155** (the same ceiling, recorded independently).

## Grading notes

- **Clause-② `yes`**, and the largest one in the programme.
- **Governed surface**: AGENTS.md §5 #0.1 ⇒ draft PR + human merge, ⛔ never auto-merged.
- ⚠️ The removal does **not** buy a type error for every misspelling on its own: #8174 records the honest bound — declaring a key buys editor completion, doc-snippet fidelity and one honest face. The **refusal** comes from the zod strict face (#8345). ⇒ the two faces are complements, and this card ⛔ must not be sold as the one that catches misspellings at runtime.

## ⛔ Unblocks when

All eight per-package rulings (**#8648–#8655**) have been adjudicated **and** #8345's remainder is settled. ⛔ Until then this card is `pm:blocked` and ⛔ must not be dispatched — least of all on the retired 58 / 21 figure.

Refs: #5250 (the ruling) · #7927 (ruled: removal) · #7935 (this pricing) · **#8327** (the corrected census, and the re-scope ruling) · #7804 · #7780 · #7924 · #7925 · #7928 · #8174 · #6152 · #5155 · #7497 · #8648–#8655
